summary: FiscalNote Holdings filed an 8-K to disclose amendments to forbearance agreements with subordinated creditors GPO FN Noteholder and YA II PN, dated April 21, 2026 and amended May 18, 2026. The creditors agreed to waive defaults under subordinated convertible debt instruments arising from the delisting of the Company's Class A common stock from the NYSE and to forbear from exercising related rights until June 21, 2026. This is a routine amendment extending forbearance, not a standalone special situation event. The filing does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other transformative transaction. Watch for potential restructuring or going-private efforts if delisting persists.
